selected_branches.branch: Start from a parked position on a highway
required_context: Establish highway boundaries, public-authority dedication and public vehicular use.
Place an ordinary motor vehicle initially parked within those boundaries, with no actual loading, unloading or passenger exchange.
Supply the location-specific legal basis establishing that parking is permitted at the relevant time.
Specify the other vehicle's classification, route, position, motion and purpose relative to the departure.

law_text: A person, except when stopping, standing or parking where no parking is permitted, shall not start a vehicle which is stopped, standing or parked on a highway nor enter upon a highway unless and until such movement can be made with safety.
